description: This Java class 'UserService' provides core user management functionalities such as creating, updating, and patching user data within a Spring-based application. It interacts with repositories for persistence and uses security features like password encoding.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class managing user creation and updates, integrating with repositories and encoding passwords.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user after validating username and email uniqueness, encodes password, and assigns 'USER' role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user information such as name, email, and image URL for an existing user.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Partially updates user details, specifically 'detalle' field.
